text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: service=router-proxy-us-east - alert=5xx-rate - threshold=3% - window=1m - link: https://pd.redwood/INCIDENT/ABC123
pagerduty-bot: Escalation: Primary oncall @sam_lewis (round-robin). PagerDuty incident ABC123 created.
sam_lewis: acked the incident. Looking into logs now.
maria_g: seeing a 5xx spike in graphs, but it's almost entirely from the canary runner IPs in eu-west-1. No real customer traffic hit yet.
sam_lewis: running a quick grep on proxy logs to confirm source...
sam_lewis: ```bash
kubectl logs -n infra deploy/router-proxy -c proxy --since=2m | grep ' 5.. ' || true
10.12.3.45 - - [15/Mar/2026:14:12:01 +0000] "POST /generate HTTP/1.1" 502 512 "-" "canary-checker/1.2"
10.12.3.46 - - [15/Mar/2026:14:12:03 +0000] "GET /_health" 503 123 "-" "kube-probe/1.18"
```
tara_ops: I think this matches the canary agent rollout noise we saw; canary tasks are flapping during startup. Started ~14:10 UTC.
sam_lewis: are we sure it's not infra? any other regions showing same pattern?
maria_g: only eu-west region canaries spiking. us-east/us-west are normal.
sam_lewis: ok. not customer-impacting for now but noisy and paging. I'll silence PD for canary noise and scale down the canary-runner temporarily.
sam_lewis: `/pd incidents ABC123 silence 30m --reason "canary job noise, no customer impact"`
pagerduty-bot: Incident ABC123 silenced for 30 minutes by sam_lewis.
devops-bot: Temporary mitigation: scaling canary-runner down to 0 replicas to stop the noisy checks.
devops-bot: ```bash
kubectl scale deployment/canary-runner -n ci --replicas=0
deployment.apps/canary-runner scaled
```
maria_g: metrics show 5xx rate dropping back to baseline within one minute after scale down.
incident-bot: PagerDuty incident ABC123 has been auto-resolved (duration 2m 18s) — reason: suppression/auto-clear.
sam_lewis: marking as no customer impact, will file follow-up. Handing off to @oncall-next for watch window.
oncall-next: taking watch for the next hour, will reopen if alerts come back. ping me directly if anything noisy reappears.
sam_lewis: added follow-up ticket INF-2345: "canary stability and circuit-breaker for canary-checker" https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-2345
maria_g: :thumbsup:
